posts.text: Why did the Trump administration sent humanitarian aid and rescuers to Venezuela after the country was hit by a destructive earthquake?  People like @The Cheetah Gworl think that it’s thanks to the fact that Trump “took over Venezuela”.  That’s not true.
posts.summary: Corrects false claim that Trump seized control of Venezuela

posts.text: Do asylum-seekers in the United States need to assimilate to the American culture? No, @zackheeter  Assimilation is cultural, while seeking asylum is an international law concept that implies someone fleeing a country to seek protection from another one. The need for “assimilation“ has been used by some to justify denying asylum and that’s not right.
posts.summary: Distinguishes asylum law from cultural assimilation requirements
